question: Who among the following Indian singers is addressed as the Nightingale of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lata Mangeshkar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lata Mangeshkar is **a singer famous as the** 'nightingale of India'** for her melody voice.
 
• She sang for above **50 years **for actresses from **Nargis to Preity Zinta, and **also recorded albums of all types **(ghazals, pop, etc)**.
 
• Lata Mangeshkar was an Indian playback singer and** infrequent music composer. **
 
• She is widely observed to have been one of the important and most** influential singers in India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84311ea5c1801ee04c130dacecae465f154a0f809db3238d5c41979b60484d75.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shreya Ghosal** is an Indian playback singer.
 
• **Arijit Singh** is an Indian singer and music composer. 
 
• **Sunidhi Chauhan **is an Indian playback singer. ​
